abstract: Mature cystic teratomas are common benign ovarian neoplasms, but rupture is a rare complication, occurring in less than 5% of cases. Peritonitis with granulomatous lesions following rupture, mimicking peritoneal carcinomatosis, is extremely rare and is not typically reported as a complication. We report the case of a 48-year-old Caucasian female with lower abdominal pain and suspected four-quadrant peritonitis. A 7.9 cm teratoma was identified on CT scan. Exploratory laparoscopy revealed numerous adhesions and fibrinous exudate. Initially, cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy were recommended due to a highly suspected malignancy, initially thought to be pseudomyxoma peritonei. However, laparotomy revealed over 50 encapsulated mucoid micronodular lesions and pronounced adhesions throughout the entire abdominal cavity. Despite the macroscopic appearance, no evidence of malignancy was found in any of the numerous frozen sections sent for analysis. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with multifocal foreign body granulomas. No malignancy was detected. It is likely that multiple (silent) ruptures of the mature cystic teratoma were responsible for this unusually pronounced inflammatory response in the whole abdomen. This case report presents a rare and unusual complication of a mature cystic teratoma, where it mimics peritoneal carcinomatosis, leading to an initial misdiagnosis. While ruptured mature cystic teratomas are known, the granulomatous inflammation and peritonitis that mimicked pseudomyxoma peritonei have not been reported in the literature. This novel presentation could significantly affect diagnostic protocols in similar cases, as it provides insight into how granulomatous reactions can present similarly to malignancy, potentially leading to unnecessary aggressive treatments such as cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は一般的な良性卵巣腫瘍であるが、破裂はまれな合併症であり、5%未満の症例で生じる。破裂後の肉芽腫病変を伴う腹膜炎は、腹膜癌腫症を模倣し極めてまれであり、通常は合併症として報告されていない。本報告では、下腹部痛と四象限の腹膜炎が疑われた48歳の白人女性例を紹介する。CTで7.9cmの奇形腫が認められた。腹腔鏡検査で多数の癒着と線維素性滲出液を認めた。悪性腫瘍が強く疑われ、当初は腹膜偽粘液腫と考えられたため、減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法が推奨された。しかし開腹術で、腹腔全体に50個を超える被包性の粘液性微小結節と高度の癒着を認めた。肉眼所見にもかかわらず、多数の術中迅速凍結切片では悪性所見は認められなかった。病理組織学的検査で、多巣性の異物型肉芽腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定し、悪性腫瘍は検出されなかった。複数回の無症候性破裂が、この著しい炎症反応の原因である可能性が高い。本症例は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が腹膜癌腫症を模倣し初期誤診に至った、まれで特異な合併症を示している。破裂した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は既知であるが、腹膜偽粘液腫を模倣する肉芽腫性炎症と腹膜炎はこれまで報告されていない。この新たな提示様式は、同様の症例の診断プロトコルに影響を及ぼす可能性があり、肉芽腫反応が悪性腫瘍と類似して見え、減量手術などの過剰な積極的治療につながりうることを示す。
